sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa
Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.

findings.why: The drawing in force (rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6. The proposed EN AW-6061-T6 is a different alloy with a typical yield of 240 MPa, below the 250 MPa minimum of SC-BR220-YS. The part card says the two are not interchangeable.

sources.quote: a change of material, a change of manufacturing process, or a change
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping after a change of material, plus 90 days' notification. No approval or deviation in force covers this change. DEV-118 is expired and covers packaging only. DEV-127 was rejected.
